text:
Anya: dropping a very compact mock — mini composer + streaming responses + a tiny token-budget bar. want quick takes on behavior, copy, and a11y.
Matt: neat. question: do we update the budget bar live as tokens stream or at fixed intervals?
Anya: live is ideal but low-attention. show smooth numeric growth, no flashy motion.
Sophia: a11y: continuous changes = noise for screen readers. only announce significant milestones or final totals.
DesignBot: recs: role=status for final totals, aria-atomic=true for definitive posts, and use aria-hidden for intermediate increments.
Jess: UX idea: add a small cost-preview chip next to Regenerate that says e.g. "cost +~30" that expands on hover/click for details.
Matt: prefer hidden-by-default; expose via library prefs. also, batch UI updates (250ms) to avoid repaint churn.
Ryan: stop vs pause: product asked for minimal chrome. suggestion: long-press on FAB = stop, tap = pause/preview? that feels discoverable?
Anya: risky for discoverability. simpler: tap stops (keeps partial), overflow menu has "preview pause" & "regenerate". long-press could be a mobile shortcut but not primary.
Sophia: mobile a11y: long-press less consistent for assistive tech. keep explicit menu items and keyboard-accessible controls.
Jess: copy nominations: FAB tooltip -> "Stop". overflow menu: "Regenerate" + small hint line: "Estimate: ~+30 tokens". cost preview panel label: "Estimated extra tokens"
Matt: microcopy tweak: prefer verbs first: "Stop", "Regenerate". hints can be sentence fragments.
Anya: design notes: token-budget bar is a slim horizontal under the bubble: used/current/limit with color zones (green/yellow/red). on large jumps show subtle flash of the bar for 200ms.
DesignBot: color-only is a no-go. include chevrons or numeric badges; ensure contrast >=4.5:1. provide text alternatives for color zones.
Ryan: prompt library interaction: when a prompt is pinned, the cost preview should show both with-and-without the pinned prompt; label them clearly.
Sophia: pinned preview must be editable inline and open full editor on focus. ensure screen readers can inspect the preview content.
Jess: regen confirmations: inline confirm for huge deltas (>700 tokens) with a short explanation: "This will consume ~700 tokens. Continue?" small checkbox "Dont ask again for this session" optional.
Matt: engineering: add telemetry events: token_preview_shown, regen_confirm_shown, regen_confirmed with before/after estimates and pinned_prompt_id. also debounce stream updates to 250ms.
Anya: edge-case: partial JSON outputs — if user stops mid-JSON, we surface a small "fix formatting" affordance that suggests a quick regen with JSON-mode.
Ryan: love that. also add a tiny "save partial" bookmark so users can snapshot a partial reply before regen.
Sophia: accessibility nit: focus order when overflow menu opens must be logical; trap focus in modal confirms. provide keyboard-visible outlines and >3px focus ring.
Jess: copy alternatives to test in usability: (A) "Stop generation — keep partial reply" (B) "Stop — keep current text". For regen toast: "Regenerating (~+30 tokens)" vs "Rerunning (cost +~30)".
Matt: will prototype debounce + budget bar animation in playground branch. will include a11y hooks as noted.
Anya: next steps: produce two visual variants (bar under bubble vs mini pill corner), capture copy A/B, and wire telemetry names in the spec.
DesignBot: summary: update interval=250ms, announce only final/thresholds, color+icon for zones, keyboard-accessible breakdown panel, regen confirmation threshold=700 tokens.
Ryan: I'll add events to the product spec and flag integration points for dedicated/private deployments (KMS logging of confirm decisions).
Jess: I'll post finalized copy options and small UX test script by EOD.
Anya: thanks everyone  ping when mocks/PRs land :wave:
